reasoning_notes: For each candidate I matched its reported event types against the 7 causal_chains to find the single best-fitting chain, then checked four things per candidate: (1) chain integrity - do ALL reported event types belong to that one chain, or are some drawn from unrelated chains (a sign of a coincidental mashup of separate background incidents); (2) causal order - when sorted by first_seen_day, do the events appear in the same order as their position in the causal chain (a genuine progression unfolds forward in time; a decoy has steps arriving out of sequence, e.g. the 'downstream' event reported before its 'upstream' cause); (3) corroboration breadth per link - independent_sources/distinct_sites/distinct_regions for the WEAKEST link in the chain, since a real cross-organisational risk needs every step (not just the loudest one) independently corroborated from more than one site, not just one team's routine chatter or a single work note; (4) contradiction rate as a minor penalty. Candidates that failed on chain integrity (C-16: 7 event types spanning 5+ unrelated chains, only 2 matching any single chain) or causal order (C-4, C-9, C-11, C-22, C-26, C-38, C-43 - each has at least one step whose first_seen_day precedes an earlier causal step, meaning the 'progression' is illusory even when sourcing looks strong, as in C-26/C-9) were ranked at the bottom as clear artefacts. Among the remaining single-chain, correctly-ordered candidates, I drew the real/artefact line at whether EVERY link in the chain was corroborated by at least 2 distinct sites (not merely 2 reports from the same site, and not a single-report link, which the task explicitly calls out as artefact behaviour). This yielded 24 candidates as genuine emerging cross-organisational risks; the remainder are single-chain, correctly-ordered stories but with at least one step resting on a single site or a single report - plausible smoke but not yet independently confirmed across the organisation, so kept out of the executive-facing set despite ranking above the order-violating and chain-scattered artefacts.
